grid_origin: first observed timestamp in each recording
snapshot_rule: latest raw observation at or before the grid time
duplicate_timestamp_rule: keep the last row in original file order and count the removals
stale_snapshot_rule: unavailable; reject any sample with unavailable lookback or target
history_endpoint_rule: include both endpoints, giving 121 grid snapshots
target_definition: latest available raw PM10 snapshot at the target grid time
future_context_rule: do not use event duration, episode identity, elapsed event time or future activity labels as features
partition_rule: hold out whole labelled experiment groups and every recording within them
outdoor_recordings: excluded from initial task; retained for a later separately declared investigation
limitations: Twelve laboratory recordings from one sensor and one published experimental setup
Three laboratory OPC files lack a calendar date; a strict global chronological split is not claimed
Several timestamps are rounded to whole seconds, with duplicates and small gaps
The final group is labelled temperature increased and tests a different experimental condition
The latest observed snapshot can be up to 1.5 seconds old
No claim of calibrated gravimetric accuracy, outdoor boundary accuracy or misting effectiveness
